# SolidCqrsFramework

## Scope and Context (Token Discipline)
- Repo scope: shared CQRS/event-sourcing framework only.
- Keep responses concise and file-focused; avoid cross-repo context unless asked.

## Domain Essence
- Reusable CQRS patterns and infrastructure used by candidate/employer services.

## Guidelines
- Favor backward-compatible changes; avoid breaking interfaces without approval.
- Keep public APIs minimal and stable.
- Update documentation when adding new abstractions.
